observations: The dispatcher enforced the PLAN grant, but the immutable builder context contains no checkpoint-derived approval attestation. The builder reports that it cannot establish approval.
OpenCode emitted a commentary text event before its final JSON. parse_output concatenates all OpenCode text events and fails JSON decoding.
The final JSON itself is parseable but uses invalid result status BLOCKED and verdict FAIL. Do not accept or rewrite it.
Builder attempted schema reads from the control worktree and OpenCode denied external_directory access. Matching schema files exist inside the pilot execution root. Permissions were not bypassed.
proposed_bounded_correction: Engine._prepare: include non-consumable checkpoint-derived PLAN approval attestation bound to the active plan, scope, stage and repository; never expose owner token files. Include explicit execution-root schema paths.
adapters.parse_output: distinguish final OpenCode response from earlier commentary using native message metadata; retain strict JSON and schema validation, rejecting ambiguous/malformed results.
Add targeted regressions for approval context, local schema paths, commentary/final response separation and invalid result rejection. Rerun the full suite and regenerate freeze after approval.
Reconcile the stopped rejected job using this evidence and retry the builder under the existing standing PLAN grant. Preserve raw output and permission restrictions.
